SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date, channels, target_group, mailing_list_size, holdout_size
FROM dim_campaign
WHERE campaign_name LIKE '%Spring Garden Launch%'
ORDER BY campaign_id DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as contacted_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

-- Members who were contacted in the campaign
WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT SUM(net_amount) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM contacted_members)
AND sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND sale_date <= '2026-05-24'

-- Verify: compare mailing list size vs actual exposures
SELECT 
  c.mailing_list_size,
  c.holdout_size,
  (c.mailing_list_size - c.holdout_size) as expected_contacted,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id = 19) as actual_contacted
FROM dim_campaign c
WHERE c.campaign_id = 19

-- Check the date range of sales for contacted members
WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as earliest_sale,
  MAX(sale_date) as latest_sale,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) as total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM contacted_members)
AND sale_date >= '2026-05-04'
AND sale_date <= '2026-05-24'
